glosses: Rendre plus riche en tanin.
A light, brown-like colour.
A darkening of the skin resulting from exposure to sunlight or similar light sources.

examples.text: She still has a tan from her vacation in Mexico.
I'm hoping to get a tan this weekend at the beach.

glosses: The bark of an oak or other tree from which tannic acid is obtained.

examples.text: In two pints of water boil one ounce of tan, and a like portion of nutgall till reduced to a pint.

glosses: Yellowish-brown.

examples.text: Mine is the white car parked next to the tan pickup truck.

glosses: Having dark skin as a result of exposure to the sun or an artificial process intended to mimic this effect.

examples.text: You’re looking very tan this week.

glosses: To change to a tan colour due to exposure to the sun.

examples.text: No matter how long I stay out in the sun, I never tan, though I do burn.

glosses: To change an animal hide into leather by soaking it in tannic acid. To work as a tanner.
To spank or beat.

examples.text: "Well, go 'long and play; but mind you get back some time in a week, or I'll tan you."
